edges.reason: transfer delegates the whole operation to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders to enforce sale limits.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from address of transferFrom.
transferFrom reads msg.sender for the allowance check and allowance decrement.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum updates.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-supplied data.
delegate gates the delegatecall only on msg.sender == owner.
init scales token and maxToken with unchecked 10**uint256(decimals).
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing the sale gate.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against a hardcoded address whitelist.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor assigns owner from the deployer address.
constructor reads msg.sender for owner, balance seeding and transfer event.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
batchSend subtracts from the sender and adds to each recipient in balanceOf.
condition reads _minSale to bound the sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the sale amount.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.

init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.

ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
